rungs.title: Engineering Manager
rungs.summary: Leads an engineering team: its people, its delivery and its quality.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the team's systems well enough to judge the trade-offs, and people management well enough to be fair.
rungs.delivery: Owns a team's delivery and quality, and the plan that gets it there.
rungs.leadership: Runs one-to-ones, hires, gives honest feedback and represents the team to product and leadership.

rungs.title: Head of Engineering
rungs.summary: Leads several teams and the engineering process.
rungs.knowledge: Connects architecture, security, infrastructure and delivery across teams.
rungs.delivery: Owns delivery across teams, the engineering budget and the technical risk register.
rungs.leadership: Manages managers, sets engineering culture and speaks for engineering to the business.

rungs.title: VP Engineering
rungs.summary: Owns the whole engineering organisation and its results.
rungs.knowledge: Reads finance, data and AI strategy well enough to defend technology choices to the board.
rungs.delivery: Owns engineering output, cost, reliability and security for the company.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders, builds the organisation and is the executive team's technical conscience.

rungs.title: CTO
rungs.summary: Owns technology strategy and answers for it to the board.
rungs.knowledge: Sees technology, security, finance, regulation and AI as one picture and the market it sits in.
rungs.delivery: Sets and delivers technology strategy; owns architecture, security posture and technical hiring.
rungs.leadership: Leads the engineering leadership, represents technology to customers, investors and the board.
